MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The smart plug feels like a useful next step because it would let my existing Alexa devices control a lamp, adding something I cannot already do with a speaker alone.",
    "The memory card, reader and USB adapters connect with my history of using storage and computer peripherals, so their practical purpose makes sense even though I would need to confirm a current need."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The older Fire TV sticks and Echo Dot repeat needs already covered by my recently purchased 4K Max and fourth-generation Dot, without giving me a clear reason to add another device.",
    "The first-generation Show 5 feels redundant after my second-generation Show 5 and matching stand. A larger Show 8 is interesting, but my current display already meets my needs.",
    "The tablets do not connect to a task I am currently trying to accomplish; owning Alexa devices does not mean I am looking for a tablet."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My recent Amazon device purchases seem to have been taken as interest in almost any Amazon device, including older products that duplicate what I own.",
    "My purchases of computer and storage accessories seem to imply an ongoing need for more accessories, even when I already have equipment that serves the same purpose."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent purchases matter because they can satisfy a need: buying a newer device makes an older version less appealing unless I have a separate use for it.",
    "My Show stand and Harmony replacement batteries suggest that making existing equipment more useful or keeping it working can matter more to me than adding another similar device.",
    "Compatibility and a specific unmet need determine whether I would buy an accessory. I would check my computer's ports before buying USB-C adapters, and my existing multi-format reader reduces the appeal of another reader."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my interest in connected home devices and practical peripherals, but miss the difference between extending what I own and duplicating needs I have already met."
}
